# toml++

TabTail vendors the unmodified, header-only amalgamation of toml++ v3.4.0.

- Source: https://github.com/marzer/tomlplusplus/tree/v3.4.0
- Header: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/marzer/tomlplusplus/v3.4.0/toml.hpp
- SHA-256: `6b5172ad4dd6519aec67b919181fa7a38a2234131e5b2afa232dfe444819783e`
- License: MIT (see LICENSE).

CMake verifies the header checksum. No toml++ binary library or runtime dependency is required.
